title: Emergencies & health

grammar.title: The words you hope not to need
grammar.body: Learn these cold. **Ayuda** (help), **necesito un doctor**, and **¿dónde está el baño?** are the ones you'll actually use. Mexico's emergency number is **911**. A **farmacia** can help with minor things fast.

canDo: Ask for help, a doctor, or the police
Say you're sick or allergic to something

items.note: Shout it if you need to: '¡Ayuda!'
Woman: soy alérgica. e.g. …a los cacahuates (peanuts).

comprehension.reply: está muy cerca, a dos calles
comprehension.english: It's very close, two streets away.
comprehension.question: How far is the hospital?
